# Where to Watch The Royal


by Angel | August 20, 2026


What happens when you’ve reached the highest point of your career, only to lose nearly everything?


*The Royal* tells the remarkable true story of Willie Mays Aikens, a Kansas City Royals star whose journey takes him from baseball stardom through addiction and incarceration—and ultimately toward healing, faith, and redemption.


[Watch The Royal now, only on Angel.](https://www.angel.com/watch/royal)


### **From Baseball Stardom to Rock Bottom**


Willie Mays Aikens knows what it feels like to have the world watching.


As a professional baseball player for the Kansas City Royals, he's reached the heights many athletes dream of. But behind the career and the spotlight, Willie is fighting a battle that threatens to consume everything he’s built.


Addiction changes the course of his life, eventually leading to incarceration and years of consequences that extend far beyond the baseball field.


For Willie, the hardest part of his story is only beginning.


### **The Long Road Back**


Leaving prison doesn’t mean leaving the past behind. As Willie works to rebuild his life, he has to reckon with the choices that brought him there and the relationships affected along the way. The road forward isn’t simple, but with the support of his family and a renewed faith, he begins taking steps toward something he once thought might be out of reach: a second chance.


*The Royal* follows that journey with an honest look at the setbacks, difficult choices, and moments of hope along the way.


### **More Than a Baseball Story**


While baseball is an important part of Willie’s story, *The Royal* is ultimately about what happens after the cheering stops.


The film explores addiction, incarceration, family, forgiveness, and the challenge of rebuilding a life after devastating mistakes. It also asks viewers to look beyond someone’s worst decisions and consider the person who remains on the other side of them.


One Guild member said the film changed their perspective on drug crimes and the way people who commit them are treated, recognizing that they had previously been judgmental in a negative way.


That’s part of what makes Willie’s story so powerful. It’s not simply about falling from success. It’s about discovering that failure doesn’t have to be the final chapter.


### **Watch** ***The Royal*** **on Angel**


If you’re looking for an inspiring true story that goes beyond the headlines to explore resilience, forgiveness, and the possibility of starting again, *The Royal* offers a powerful look at one man’s remarkable journey.


[Stream The Royal today, only on Angel.](https://www.angel.com/watch/royal)
